Multi Select

Multi Select allows users to select multiple options displayed as tags. It supports search, max selection limits, and disabled options.

Basic Multi Select

A multi-select with tag display and remove capability.

HTML 
<select class="zak-input" data-zak-multiselect multiple
        data-zak-multiselect-placeholder="Type to add skills...">
  <option value="javascript" selected>JavaScript</option>
  <option value="css" selected>CSS</option>
  <option value="html">HTML</option>
  <option value="typescript">TypeScript</option>
  <option value="python">Python</option>
  <option value="sql">SQL</option>
</select>

Searchable Multi Select

Filter options by typing in the search field.

Type in the field to filter the options.
HTML 
<select class="zak-input" data-zak-multiselect multiple
        data-zak-multiselect-placeholder="Search technologies...">
  <option value="react" selected>React</option>
  <option value="angular">Angular</option>
  <option value="vue">Vue.js</option>
  <option value="svelte">Svelte</option>
  <option value="next">Next.js</option>
  <option value="nuxt">Nuxt</option>
</select>

Max Selection

Limit the number of selections allowed.

Up to 3 options can be selected.
HTML 
<select class="zak-input" data-zak-multiselect multiple
        data-zak-multiselect-max="3"
        data-zak-multiselect-placeholder="Max 3 selections">
  <option value="apple" selected>Apple</option>
  <option value="banana" selected>Banana</option>
  <option value="cherry">Cherry</option>
  <option value="date">Date</option>
  <option value="elderberry">Elderberry</option>
</select>

Disabled Options

Some options can be pre-disabled.

Disabled options cannot be selected.
HTML 
<select class="zak-input" data-zak-multiselect multiple
        data-zak-multiselect-placeholder="Select features...">
  <option value="basic-analytics">Basic Analytics</option>
  <option value="advanced-analytics">Advanced Analytics</option>
  <option value="custom-reports" disabled>Custom Reports (Pro Only)</option>
  <option value="white-label" disabled>White Label (Enterprise)</option>
</select>

JavaScript Demo

Interactive multi-select with add and remove functionality.

Selected: html
JavaScript 
const select = document.getElementById('ms-api');

select.addEventListener('zak:change', function (e) {
  console.log(e.detail.value); // array of selected values
  document.getElementById('ms-api-output').textContent =
    'Selected: ' + (e.detail.value.length ? e.detail.value.join(', ') : 'none');
});

CSS Classes Reference

Class Description
.zak-multi-selectContainer generated by JS (wraps tags, search and dropdown)
.zak-multi-select-tagsContainer for the selected tag badges
.zak-multi-select-searchSearch input inside the container
.zak-multi-select-dropdownDropdown options list
.zak-multi-select-optionIndividual option
.zak-multi-select-option-disabledDisabled option
.zak-multi-select-checkboxCheckbox indicator inside an option
.zak-multi-select-labelText label inside an option
.zak-multi-select-emptyNo-results message
.zak-multi-select-activeApplied to the container while the dropdown is open
.zak-selectedApplied to a selected option
.zak-activeApplied to the keyboard-highlighted option
.zak-badge-removableTag badge with a remove button

Data Attributes

The multi select is initialized automatically on any <select multiple> that carries data-zak-multiselect.

Attribute Description
data-zak-multiselectEnables the component on the select.
data-zak-multiselect-placeholderPlaceholder text for the search field. Defaults to Select....
data-zak-multiselect-maxMaximum number of selectable options (0 = unlimited).
data-zak-multiselect-searchSet to false to disable typing/filtering.
disabled (on select)Renders the whole component as disabled.
disabled (on option)Renders that option as non-selectable.

Accessibility

  • The generated container uses role="combobox" and the dropdown uses role="listbox" with aria-multiselectable="true"; each option gets role="option".
  • Selected state is exposed through aria-selected, and disabled options through aria-disabled="true".
  • Open state is reflected on the container with aria-expanded.
  • Keyboard support: arrow keys move the highlight, Enter selects, Backspace removes the last tag, and Escape/Tab closes the dropdown.
  • Bind a visible <label for="..."> to the underlying select and provide clear instructions.
